basics.name: Raffaele Trivillin
basics.label: IIoT Full Stack Developer
basics.summary: Full-stack developer with 7 years of experience designing and developing cloud and on-premises applications, now specializing in industrial digitalization and MES/MOM systems on the .NET stack. I follow the product from requirements gathered on the shop floor through to release and support: architectural decisions, integration with automation systems (OPC UA, Siemens PLCs), team coordination, and dialogue with management and customers.
